extraction.Name: Frank Ducharme
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not at the time of delivery but the Farmer had told me a few days before delivery that I would have to take it because it had been de issued and that I would have to pay taxes any way. This was after I had told the farmer that I did not want it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I signed it over to a loan company last year. I have a mortgage on both quarters.
extraction.Buyer: Alice M. Hettinger (loan company); mortgage on both quarters
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I had to get money some way to take care of the taxes. I got $1500 for a mortgage on each quarter but the taxes and interest amounts to more than $2000 on each quarter now.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I farm, milk cows and raise hogs.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1918 at the Bank of Herrick, Herrick, S.D., by Narcisse McKenzie, the interpreter at the Ponca issue station at that time. Allottee still has one quarter of the land; the other was signed over to a loan company. No children. Not in good health for the last 3 or 4 years. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, on April 30, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32.
